{{Recipe summary
| Category = Egg recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], room temperature and beaten
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of fine-grain [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterey Jack]] cheese, room temperature
* ½ cup grated [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]], room temperature 
* ¼ cup grated mild [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|Cheddar cheese]], room temperature
* 2 ½ slices [[Cookbook:Pepper Jack|pepper jack cheese]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] extremely fine and at room temperature
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]

== Procedure ==
#Heat a small nonstick [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium high heat until butter bubbles nicely when you swirl it around.
#If you did not swirl the butter around the pan already, do so now. Add eggs and salt to pan and cook until nicely browned on side facing pan.
#Sprinkle cheeses over half the uncooked side of eggs. Fold the eggs in half, then cook just until cheese has been melted and heated through. Serve.
